artifacts.notes: Normalized transcription, not a facsimile or critical edition. Historical Latin wording is public domain in the United States; portal markup and translations have separate rights. Historical witness: Acta Apostolicae Sedis 2 (1910), pp. 567–568. Uncollated normalized web transcription; source wording and numbering retained apart from the explicitly recorded corrections and apparatus exclusions. Terminal date is 28 May 1910, unlike catalog index date 9 May. Historical Merry del Val signature retained. The official indexes give conflicting act dates. The reviewed act date is 1910-05-28, identified at https://www.vatican.va/archive/aas/documents/AAS-02-1910-ocr.pdf printed pp. 567–568; dating clause p. 568.
artifacts.rights_basis: Historical Latin wording identified in Acta Apostolicae Sedis 2 (1910), pp. 567–568, published by 1930. United States expired-term assessment under 17 U.S.C. 304/305; qualifying foreign restoration under 104A(a)(1)(B) only receives the remaining term. Under 103(b), this covers preexisting historical wording rather than modern creative additions. Vatican HTML, translations of later date, and scan/reprint wrappers have separate rights. See src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml.
